name: Ganges Lava Sea
notes: Extreme zone where magma meets ocean. Deep-sea vent lineages were pushed to the surface here and evolved obsidian carapaces that withstand direct magma exposure; extremophile gastropods fuse basalt and metallic ore into armoured shells along the lake shores. The bestiary groups the magmatic and glacial extremes together, with underworld portals at the far end. Species here default to rare.
